title: Red Hat Security Advisory: cockpit security update
description: Two security vulnerabilities affecting the Cockpit web-based server administration tool in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support have been addressed. One vulnerability (CVE-2026-91151) allows local privilege escalation due to insecure symbolic link handling in the public key addition helper. The other (CVE-2026-91150) is a denial of service caused by unbounded fragmented WebSocket messages. Red Hat has released updates to fix these issues in the Cockpit packages for multiple architectures.
